scientific_integrity: The exact orbit formula and identification of solution automorphism groups are credited to Militaru; the new statements are the joint-size asymptotic, limiting size shift, and class-weighted asymptotic rigidity. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Only bipartite set-theoretic Yang–Baxter solutions are enumerated.
Uniform measure is on isomorphism classes, not labeled solutions.
No explicit multiplicative saddle-point prefactor is evaluated.
Unindexed or differently formulated asymptotic conjugacy literature could contain a prior implication.
title: Asymptotic rigidity and the shifted size law for bipartite Yang–Baxter solutions
